# Micrologic Integrated Systems
# https://www.micrologicglobal.com

## About
Micrologic Integrated Systems is a manufacturing automation company based in Bengaluru, India. We design and deliver automated assembly lines, end-of-line test systems, production traceability solutions, and Industry 4.0 digital transformation platforms for automotive, electric vehicle, electronics, and medical device manufacturers.

## Solutions
- Assembly Automation: Conveyors, robotic automation, rotary indexing, cellular cells, vision inspection
- Test Solutions: ICT, FCT, EOL testing, RF testing, burn-in testing, vibration screening
- Traceability: Micrologic Traceware for part tracking, process monitoring, error-proofing (poka-yoke)
- Digital Transformation: FactEyes cloud analytics platform with OEE, SPC, predictive maintenance

## Products
- Automated Test Cells
- Automated Assembly Cells
- BON Test Fixtures
- MTS Test Software Platform
- RF Shielded Test Enclosures
- Robotic Automation Cells
- Traceware Platform

## Industries Served
- Automotive
- Electric Vehicles (EV)
- Electrical & Electronics
- Medical Devices
